Messages.Author: Madman2001
Messages.Body:
Folks:

1. In my playgroup, I notice a number of folks use Cats' Guidance
during or even at the end of combat. However, strictly speaking, if I
understand the card correctly, Cats' Guidance can only be used after
the block is successful and before combat begins (before pre-range).
Correct?

2. Let's say that a 1-blood Ingrid diablerizes another vampire with
lots of blood and with a Flamethrower. Fancifully speaking, can Ingrid
get to Heidelberg Castle before the Blood Hunt catches up with her, so
she can give her blood and weapon to another vampire? You can only use
the Castle between actions, but I am not sure whether the Blood Hunt is
considered a part of the action during which the vampire was
diablerized. LMK, LSJ.

Danke,
Madman

Well, with the case of blood it doesn't matter because excess blood is removed
immediately. Thus even if there wasn't any bloodhunt called, the extra blood
would go to the blood bank before being transferable with the Castle.

However, if the question was concerning equipment, then I'm not exactly sure.
My instincts tell me that there wouldn't be enough time to use Heidelburg since
Blood Hunt is supposed to be immediate and all but...LSJ?

Halcyan 2

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
*****
New Rules Analysis Included Below
*****

halc...@aol.com (Halcyan 2) wrote:
> >2. Let's say that a 1-blood Ingrid diablerizes another vampire with
> >lots of blood and with a Flamethrower. Fancifully speaking, can
> >Ingrid get to Heidelberg Castle before the Blood Hunt catches up
> >with her, so she can give her blood and weapon to another vampire?
> >You can only use the Castle between actions, but I am not sure
> >whether the Blood Hunt is considered a part of the action during
> >which the vampire was diablerized.
>
> Well, with the case of blood it doesn't matter because excess blood
> is removed immediately. Thus even if there wasn't any bloodhunt
> called, the extra blood would go to the blood bank before being
> transferable with the Castle.

Well, the blood in excess of capacity would drain off, but the
example seems to be concerned about the newly-gained blood that
is not in excess of capacity.

> However, if the question was concerning equipment, then I'm not
> exactly sure. My instincts tell me that there wouldn't be enough
> time to use Heidelburg since Blood Hunt is supposed to be immediate
> and all but...LSJ?

Good instincts. The "proper" answer is that Heidelburg cannot be used
between a diablerie-equipment-move [6.5.5.2] and the
diablerie-bloodhunt [6.5.5.5].

As James Coupe points out (in a parallel response to Halcyan2's
message), the Blood Hunt (as previously stated by me) is not part
of the action, which makes the "proper" answer hard to justify.

Other mildly interesting scenarios could be developed with the use
of Day/Dawn Diablerie (can you burn him in a Blood Hunt before he
goes to torpor? or can you wait until after he goes to torpor
so that he can't cast his votes, assuming he has a title?)

And the question of whether a Freak Drive is played before or after
the Blood Hunt would come up.

So the "problem" is not really the Castle, it's in the hard-to-pin
status (and timing) of the Blood Hunt referendum.

The Blood Hunt should be part of the "resolution" of a diablerie
(as specified in the Revised Rulebook, section 6.5.5).

The Blood Hunt itself is not an action (as specified in each of the
rulebooks) - it can't be blocked, can be called by a "non-active"
Methuselah, and action modifiers and reaction cards cannot be played.

I've been overstating the last part when I've said "modifiers and
reactions cannot be played because there is no action to modify
or react to". The case is properly stated as the rulebooks state:
"calling the Blood Hunt is not an action" - which doesn't mean
that there is no action taking place. Action Modifiers (like
Bewitching Oration) and Reaction cards (like Surprise Influence,
Delaying Tactics, and Political Backlash) cannot be played on the
Blood Hunt referendum because *that* is not an action - not because
there is no action at all.

To sum up:
The Blood Hunt is conducted at the time of diablerie (during the
resolution of a Diablerie action, for instance). After the Blood
Hunt, the acting vampire (if he's still around) can play Freak
Drive or be affected by "after action" effects like Daring the
Dawn or Day Operation, etc.

Hopefully that will resolve all of the conflicts about that.
My apologies for the earlier (misleading) overstatements.
